en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Haroun, from Abu ahya Al Wasity, raising it, said,

‘I asked himasws about two men taking to each other. Heasws said: ‘The Penalty (Hadd) for both of them is the Penalty (Hadd) of the adulterer. So the active one of the two upon his companions, would be struck with one strike with the sword, it takes from him what it takes, and leave from him what it leaves, intending his being killed by it; and the passive one would be burnt in the fire’.
